heroHeadline: BRICS FM Meeting Ends Without Joint Statement as Iran-UAE Confrontation Fractures Bloc Consensus
heroSubtitle: India's first major ministerial event under its 2026 BRICS chairmanship collapsed into a diplomatic setback on May 15: Iran FM Araghchi publicly accused fellow BRICS member UAE of direct military involvement against Iran, prompting the UAE to block the joint communiqué. India's Jaishankar issued a Chair's Summary only. PM Modi held historic bilateral meetings with FM Lavrov and FM Araghchi — the first India-Iran high-level contact since the Iran conflict escalated. The NDB held its 11th Annual Meeting simultaneously in Moscow. BRICS payment infrastructure talks advanced via RBI-chaired virtual sessions (May 12-13). The 18th BRICS Summit remains on track for September 12-13 in New Delhi.
footerNote: Data sourced from official BRICS declarations, NDB annual reports, IMF, and major international outlets. Source tiers reflect editorial confidence levels.
